name: minimalist-ui
summary: Agent skill that enforces warm-monochrome editorial minimalism: bento grids, serif headings, no gradients.
description: A SKILL.md protocol for AI coding agents: warm monochrome palette with ultra-desaturated pastel accents, serif headings with tight tracking, geometric sans body text, monospace code, off-black text on warm bone backgrounds, 1px solid #EAEAEA borders, bento grids and flat buttons with micro-interactions. It bans Inter, Roboto and Open Sans, Lucide/Feather/Heroicons icons, heavy shadows, gradients, pill shapes for large elements, emojis and AI copywriting clichés.
contains: palette: warm monochrome with muted pastel accents
type: serif headings, geometric sans body, monospace code
bans Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lucide, Feather and Heroicons
component specs: bento grids, flat buttons, pill badges, keystroke UI, faux-OS window chrome
motion limited to fade-ins and hover lifts
